## 🔧 Technical Details

### Integration Pattern: Wrapper
```
AI_agents Tool Registry
    ↓
tools/implementations/calculator.py (WRAPPER - to create)
    ↓
UI/external/modules/calculator-module/ORIGINAL/complete_calculator_implementation.py (COPIED)
```

### Why Wrapper Pattern?
✅ No modification of original calculator code  
✅ Easy updates (replace ORIGINAL folder)  
✅ Clean separation of concerns  
✅ Standard AI_agents tool pattern  
✅ Credential injection ready  

### Database Options:
1. **No Database** (Business Cards only) - Deploy immediately
2. **SQLite Export** (All calculators) - Requires migration
3. **SQL Server** (Production) - Requires connection
